items.evidence: Second-pass evidence stands: BatchOccurrenceBinding owns and PhaseOccurrence borrows (cross_file/types.rs:60-67, project_phase/types.rs:64-74); the parts structs add no Arc. evaluate_rules (batch_test.rs:45-91) borrows its inputs and hands borrowed PhaseOccurrences to the phase, with no clone to escape a lifetime.

compile_fail goes 60 -> 61, and the +1 is the accepted E0603 probe (prepared_execution/types.rs:7). ProgramParts/SessionParts are crate-private under private_interfaces=deny (Cargo.toml:83), and all 12 probes are deleted. The second library-surface entry is dropped. pub mod admission is unchanged from the base, and ApplicabilityProof is already public via RootOutcome::Skipped. d554903903 adds no probe or rule.

Second-pass evidence stands: evaluate_occurrences allocates its Vecs once per phase (project_phase/service.rs:63-126), and the observation route once per batch (cross_file/service.rs:128-163). No per-row allocation, SipHash or dyn is added. d554903903 is test code only.

One production phase call, evaluate_occurrences (project_phase/interface.rs:55-67), serves ordinary/service.rs:59 and cross_file/service.rs:171; PreparedProject, ReadyProject, evaluate_batch and preparation are deleted. F4.2 is repaired: evaluate_prepared is deleted, and evaluate_rules (batch_test.rs:45-91) has no loop, only one call to evaluate_occurrences over one facts port with Bucket(rule) rows (fixtures.rs:256-282). The budget case (budget_test.rs:79-118) passes within as the guard and proves the production Refused path (project_phase/service.rs:121-134,145-149). evaluate_fixture (batch_test.rs:93-133) is one evaluate plus complete_occurrence, with no zip-back.
No hand-written mechanism replaces a crate. FxHashMap is kept, compile_rules uses ryo_matching, and ScriptedMemory is a test fake (budget_test.rs:230-243).

Expected values are unchanged: budget completed 1, used 200/budget 100, reductions 1, aggregates 2, slots 1 (budget_test.rs:96-115); root-set aggregates 2 and slots 1 (root_set_test.rs:57-58). The cases move back to the production call with the stated reason, and core is green at 119/0. The ordinary case keeps rule 0 at Bucket(0) only (budget_test.rs:253), so rule 1 still answers missing frontier bucket.

No unsafe or #[allow] is added. The expect/panic and indexing d554903903 adds are in fixtures and tests only (fixtures.rs:276,315; batch_test.rs:57,85,88,122,127). The production paths answer PhaseStop/OperatingError (project_phase/service.rs:135,203-207; cross_file/service.rs:165-170).

advisories: A1: lint/use_case.rs:184 asks for kind_vocabularies() on every lint request.
A2: compile_rules/use_case.rs:62-66 uses unwrap_or_default for an out-of-range rule index; it needs a new RuleCompilationError variant (owner's call).
A3: poll(..., &mut PollMode) is an in-out parameter.

A5: tastemaker/rules/project-batch-owner/0.1.0 help and why name the deleted preparation/SealedBatch/evaluate_batch. Publish a new version naming evaluate_occurrences and relock. evaluate now has only test callers in core, so taking it off the public trait would let the compiler enforce that half of the rule.
